summary: Demo test on FastAPI web-tool to check SPHEREx photos by period.
details:
Our project is an interactive web application that allows users to explore real astronomical data from NASA's SPHEREx telescope. Users can search for celestial objects by name or coordinates, view FITS images, and identify objects within telescope observations.
Technologies: Python, FastAPI, Astropy, SQLite, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and NASA SPHEREx data.
Goal: Make astronomical observations accessible, simplify space data analysis, and support the exploration of celestial objects.
